keyTakeaways: The SurtitleLive account holder can turn off supported generative AI processing from Organization Settings.
Script editing, standard machine translation, language detection and live surtitle operation can remain available.
Turning off generative AI does not delete scripts, translations or other work already saved in SurtitleLive.
The setting does not prevent every external service or every form of machine learning from processing selected content.

faq.question: Can I turn off all AI in SurtitleLive?
faq.answer: No. This setting turns off supported generative AI processing. Standard machine translation, language detection and other non-generative tools may remain available.

faq.question: Who can turn off generative AI in SurtitleLive?
faq.answer: The SurtitleLive account holder can change the setting in Organization Settings. If no collaborators have been added, the choice affects only the account holder's own work.

faq.question: Does turning off generative AI disable translation?
faq.answer: It disables supported generative translation and generative fallbacks. Standard Google Cloud Translation can remain available in supported workflows.

faq.question: Will turning off generative AI delete existing scripts or translations?
faq.answer: No. Saved content remains available. The setting controls new generative processing rather than deleting previous work.

faq.question: What happens if collaborators use the SurtitleLive account?
faq.answer: The same generative AI setting applies to their work in SurtitleLive. Collaborators can see the saved choice but cannot change it.

glossary.definition: AI models that generate or transform content in supported SurtitleLive script and translation workflows.
The person who controls account-wide settings in SurtitleLive, including whether supported generative AI processing is allowed.
Non-generative translation provided through Google Cloud Translation in supported SurtitleLive workflows.
A choice that controls the account holder's work and also applies to collaborators added to the account.
